books_patch_queue.target_chapter_ref: books/part-06-ai-infrastructure/72-security.md#局部合理动作会累积成有害轨迹
books_patch_queue.target_section: 局部合理动作会累积成有害轨迹
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch72 already separates proposal, authorization and commit, but does not carry malicious semantic provenance through delegation. Add semantic information flow as a pre-commit safety contract.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: 多 Agent 安全不能只在每个节点重做一次 prompt classification：有害目标可被拆成局部合理的子任务。运行时应把 source、delegation、memory write 与 irreversible sink 组织成带 provenance 的语义信息流，在 sink 前重建跨节点上下文，再由确定性 policy 决定是否允许 commit。这个演进用额外图状态、标注误差和重建延迟换取跨委派风险可见性；它不替代 capability isolation，也不授权 LLM 自己决定安全。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports semantic taint propagation and workflow-level validation in the disclosed benchmarks. It does not prove labels are complete, adaptive attackers cannot evade reconstruction, or the framework withstands compromised hosts or model weights.

books_patch_queue.target_chapter_ref: books/part-05-inference-system/43-prefill.md#Sparse Prefill：少算 Attention 之前，先要付出 Selection Cost
books_patch_queue.target_section: Sparse Prefill：少算 Attention 之前，先要付出 Selection Cost
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch43 covers selection cost and sparse prefill, but not the point that ordering the mask lets kernel state refine selection. Add proxy/kernel ownership and dense fallback.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: 当 proxy 的预算继续收紧时，binary mask 不再只是“选了哪些 block”，还需要表达“先看哪些 block”。将候选按价值排序后，kernel 可先处理高置信页面，再利用 online-softmax 的运行统计决定是否跳过剩余 value work。收益来自 proxy 与 kernel 的协同，而不是更激进的静态稀疏率；代价是 mask order、page mapping 与 softmax state 都成为执行身份。短上下文、selection overhead 占优或 accuracy contract 更严格时，dense prefill 仍是正确分支。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports proxy-kernel co-design for sparse prefill in the tested models, hardware and budgets. It does not establish exactness, universal recall under tighter masks, sparse-decode benefit or cross-hardware portability.

books_patch_queue.target_chapter_ref: books/part-03-multimodal-world-models/26-multimodal-embodied-vla.md#数据演进：从专用演示到多来源对齐
books_patch_queue.target_section: 数据演进：从专用演示到多来源对齐
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch26 covers fast/slow execution but not hierarchical training supervision as a capacity substitute. Add Plan/Think as training-time state with explicit runtime and evidence boundaries.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: VLA 的容量约束不只可通过扩大 backbone 解决，也可把监督按时间尺度分层：episode-level Plan 保存慢语义，chunk-level Think 对齐当前 phase、gripper state 与 next subaction，视觉历史则保留可观察证据。这样小模型把有限容量分配给更稳定的中间状态，但 teacher trace 只是训练信号，不是物理正确性的证明；错误 Plan 还会系统性污染后续 action chunk。因此执行层仍要用 fresh observation、controller 与 safety envelope 约束动作。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports structured supervision as a capacity alternative on LIBERO-Plus. It does not prove cross-robot transfer, real-world physical safety, superiority to all larger VLAs or causal validity of natural-language rationales.

books_patch_queue.target_chapter_ref: books/part-05-inference-system/48-speculative-decoding.md#从 Token Draft 到 Read-only Tool Speculation
books_patch_queue.target_section: 从 Token Draft 到 Read-only Tool Speculation
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch48 covers read-only tool speculation but not self-model proposal training and shared prefix state. Add it while preserving effect-time authority.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: Tool speculation 的 proposal artifact 不一定是独立小模型。目标 Agent 自己可以在 partial trajectory 上切换到 speculator mode，复用 prefix KV，并用自身 rollout 产生下一次 tool call 的训练目标。这样减少了 draft/target 行为漂移，却把 speculator quality 与 Agent policy version 绑定得更紧。无论 Hit@1 多高，预测结果仍只是 proposal：只有 canonical Agent 输出匹配后才能提交副作用；不可逆工具只能预取输入或执行在隔离、可丢弃的事务中。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports reduced proposal mismatch through a dual-mode self-speculator. It does not prove wall-clock benefit, safe speculation for irreversible tools or stable performance under agent-policy updates.

books_patch_queue.target_chapter_ref: books/part-05-inference-system/48-speculative-decoding.md#一个 Target 可以对应多个 Workload-specific Proposal Artifacts
books_patch_queue.target_section: 一个 Target 可以对应多个 Workload-specific Proposal Artifacts
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch48 already allows multiple proposal artifacts, but not the batch-level verification budget that jointly depends on request confidence, load and hardware cost. Extend the control-plane contract.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: 当 MTP 与 block-diffusion 分别服务高熵对话和可预测 code/math 时，verify depth 也不能继续是单请求固定参数。调度器需要把 verifier compute 看成 batch-level shared budget，以 request confidence、expected accepted work、在线负载和硬件 cost profile 分配验证深度；target model 仍执行 exact acceptance。该机制用更高吞吐换来 artifact multiplication、routing drift、难请求饥饿与 fairness 风险，因此 homogeneous workload 或强公平 SLO 下固定预算仍可能更合适。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports workload-specialized drafters and batch-level verification allocation in the disclosed stack. It does not prove a universal drafter choice, exact transfer to other targets/hardware or stable gains under production drift.

books_patch_queue.target_section: canonical owner section selected by root
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch49 owns compiler and quantization co-design, but lacks the closed-loop evolution from analytic proxy to selective hardware calibration. Add this distinction without turning the section into a tool list.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: Mixed-precision policy 只有进入 compiler IR，才会看到 lowering、vector width、tensor-core path 与 layout 对真实成本的影响。可先用 cache bound 和表示几何等 surrogate 排除明显无效组合，再只把强候选送到目标硬件测量，并用结果在线校准 cost model。这个闭环把 quantization policy 与 compiler、hardware、benchmark identity 绑定；它减少 exhaustive HIL，却引入搜索预算、校准过拟合和版本漂移。固定硬件且代价模型成熟时，离线静态 policy 仍更简单。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports compiler-integrated, selectively measured MPQ search. It does not prove surrogate convergence, universal Pareto dominance or transfer of one policy across hardware/compiler versions.

books_patch_queue.target_section: canonical owner section selected by root
books_patch_queue.proposal: Ch66 versions EvalSpec and execution evidence but does not explicitly isolate an AI researcher’s data decision from platform variability or treat non-monotonic checkpoint selection as evaluation output.
books_patch_queue.integration_section: 评估自动化研究 Agent 时，应先冻结 training、serving、sandbox、evaluator 与 budget，让 Agent 只拥有 data-strategy 的决策权；否则一次性能变化无法归因于研究能力。每轮 checkpoint 都是不可变 evidence，final checkpoint 也不能默认等于 best checkpoint，因为连续反馈搜索可能在越过峰值后退化。这个 controlled benchmark 用较低生态真实性换取因果可解释性；通过后仍需在开放栈上复验，并把 stop rule、checkpoint selector 与 EvalSpec 一起版本化。
books_patch_queue.source_boundary: Supports isolating data-research decisions and preserving non-monotonic checkpoint trajectories. It does not prove recursive self-improvement, autonomous research reliability or transfer beyond the fixed stack.
